title: 第413章 罗刹女王归来再见玄刹姬第412章 一刀斩始祖
content_zh:
第一卷第413章罗刹女王归来，再见玄刹姬！
罗刹族众人呆呆地望着楚枫的身影，一时间竟忘了言语。
玄墨浑身颤抖，满是褶子的老脸上写满了震惊之色。
“他竟然一刀斩断了仙帝巅峰的神魂联系！”
“真正疯的人是我们，竟以为他只是个有些机缘的旁支族人，我们都瞎了眼啊！”
“玄仙六重正面硬撼仙帝巅峰，这种事说出去谁会信？”
天穹之上，司冥音脸上露出一丝复杂的神色。
她以为自己已经足够了解楚枫了，可直到此刻她才发现，自己依旧低估了他。
他只用了三天，便将这门幽罗魔宫的不传之秘练到了足以斩断仙帝巅峰神魂联系的地步。
虽然借了斗转星移阵抽取的精神力，可能将那般庞大的精神力灌入冥刃铭文之中，本身就需要极高的神魂造诣。
换做是她，就算有斗转星移阵在手，也未必能做到他这般举重若轻。
此刻她忽然发现自己错得有多离谱，就算没有她，楚枫依旧能灭了夜叉族。
“我终究还是欠他的。”
她语气中裹挟着一丝自嘲，还有一丝再也压不下去的悸动。
“还不清，根本还不清。”
神魂联系被斩断的瞬间，夜渊的神魂本源也遭到了重创。
夜叉唤祖诀以施术者自身神魂为引，神魂联系被外力强行斩断，反噬之力尽数轰入他的识海。
他抬起头，浑浊老眼中布满了蛛网般的血丝，死死盯着楚枫，眼中满是怨毒。
“夜叉族百万年的底蕴，竟被你一个小辈扼杀于此！”
他摇摇晃晃地站起身来，周身残存的仙力开始疯狂暴走，如同回光返照般轰然爆发。

“我就算是死，也要拉着你陪葬！”
他双臂张开，残躯如同一颗即将陨落的流星般朝楚枫猛扑而去。
体内的仙尊本源开始不受控制地膨胀，显然是要自爆。
一个仙尊境强者的自爆足以将方圆千里都夷为平地，他要让楚枫给他和夜叉族陪葬。
然而楚枫怎么可能给他这个机会，玄屠尸傀瞬间动了。
高大身躯如同瞬移般挡在夜渊身前，胸膛如同一面不可撼动的铜墙铁壁。
轰！
夜渊的肉身在尸傀胸前轰然炸裂，仙尊境自爆的威力堪称毁天灭地。
一道能量冲击波从爆炸中心朝四面八方疯狂席卷，所过之处虚空被炸出无数道漆黑裂缝。
可尸傀胸口的反弹铭文在自爆冲击触及的瞬间便被激活，将那股毁天灭地的自爆之力尽数反弹。
仙尊境自爆的威力何等恐怖，反弹回去的力量结结实实轰在了夜渊的神魂本源上。
他本就只剩一道残魂，被自己的自爆之力反弹回来击中，残魂差点当场崩碎。
尸傀被爆炸的冲击力震退了数十丈，当烟尘散去，夜渊已只剩一道残魂。
那缕残魂见势不妙，转身就要遁入虚空裂缝。
可他的速度再快也快不过仙王巅峰的尸傀，尸傀一只巨掌探入虚空，五指收拢，将夜渊的残魂从空间裂缝中硬生生拽了出来，捏在掌心。
“楚枫，我做鬼也不会放过你！”
“你屠我夜叉族数万族人，毁我夜叉族百万年基业，你不得好死！”
“待我死后化作厉鬼，定要日日夜夜纠缠于你！”
楚枫面对夜渊怨毒的咒骂，表情没有任何波动。
“我会让你亲眼看着夜叉族所有人死无葬身之地。”

罗刹族众人齐齐倒吸一口凉气，让一个人亲眼看着自己的族人一个接一个地死在面前，这种惩罚比直接杀了他残忍千倍。
夜渊的残魂在尸傀掌中剧烈颤抖，直到此刻他才真正体会到什么叫做绝望。
始祖神念被斩碎了，族人大半已被尸傀屠杀，他自爆都伤不到楚枫一根汗毛。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 413 Queen Rakshasa returns, see Xuansha Ji again!
Everyone in the Rakshasa clan stared blankly at Chu Feng's figure, forgetting to speak for a moment.
Xuan Mo was trembling all over, and his wrinkled old face was full of shock.
"He actually cut off the connection between the Immortal Emperor's soul and soul at the peak of his power with one strike!"
"We are the ones who are really crazy. We actually thought he was just a member of the side clan who had some luck. We are all blind!"
"The sixth level of the Mysterious Immortal is about to challenge the Immortal Emperor's peak head-on. Who would believe such a thing?"
Above the sky, Si Mingyin had a complicated expression on his face.
She thought she knew Chu Feng well enough, but it wasn't until this moment that she realized that she still underestimated him.
It only took him three days to practice the untold secrets of the Youluo Demon Palace to the point where it was enough to cut off the connection between the Immortal Emperor's peak soul.
Although it is possible to borrow the spiritual power extracted from the Star Shifting Formation to pour such huge spiritual power into the Hades Blade inscription, it itself requires extremely high spiritual attainments.
If it were her, even if she had the Star Shifting Formation in hand, she might not be able to do it with such ease.
At this moment, she suddenly realized how wrong she was. Even without her, Chu Feng could still destroy the Yasha clan.
"I still owe him after all."
There was a hint of self-deprecation in her tone, and a hint of throbbing that could no longer be suppressed.
"It's not clear, it's not clear at all."
The moment the connection between the soul and soul was severed, the origin of Ye Yuan's soul was also severely damaged.
Yaksha's Ancestor Summoning Technique is guided by the caster's own soul. The connection between the soul and soul is forcibly severed by external forces, and all the counterattack force is blasted into his sea of ​​consciousness.
He raised his head, his turbid old eyes were covered with cobweb-like bloodshot eyes, and he stared at Chu Feng, his eyes full of resentment.
"The Yaksha clan's millions of years of heritage have been snuffed out by a junior like you!"
He stood up unsteadily, and the remaining immortal power around him began to run wildly, exploding like a flashback.
"Even if I die, I will drag you to be buried with me!"
He opened his arms and his remaining body swooped towards Chu Feng like a falling meteor.
The essence of the Immortal Lord in the body began to expand uncontrollably, obviously about to self-destruct.
The self-destruction of a powerful Immortal Realm man was enough to level an area thousands of miles away. He wanted Chu Feng to be buried with him and the Yaksha Clan.
However, how could Chu Feng give him this opportunity? The Xuan Tu Corpse Puppet moved instantly.
The tall body stood in front of Ye Yuan as if teleporting, and his chest was like an unshakable copper wall.
boom!
Ye Yuan's body exploded in front of the zombie's chest, and the power of the Immortal Realm's self-destruction could be described as devastating.
An energy shock wave swept wildly from the center of the explosion in all directions, blasting countless dark cracks in the void wherever it passed.
But the rebound inscription on the corpse puppet's chest was activated the moment the self-destruction impact touched it, rebounding all the power of the self-destruction that destroyed the world.
The power of self-destruction in the Immortal Realm is so terrifying, and the power that bounces back solidly hits the origin of Ye Yuan's soul.
There was only a remnant of his soul left, but it was bounced back and hit by his own self-destruction, and the remnant soul almost collapsed on the spot.
The corpse puppet was shaken back dozens of feet by the impact of the explosion. When the smoke and dust dispersed, there was only a remnant soul left in Ye Yuan.
Seeing that the situation was not good, the remnant soul turned around and fled into the crack in the void.
But no matter how fast he was, he couldn't be faster than the corpse puppet at the peak of the Immortal King. The corpse puppet thrust a giant palm into the void, closed its five fingers, and forcefully pulled Ye Yuan's remaining soul out of the crack in space and held it in his palm.
"Chu Feng, I won't let you go even if I'm a ghost!"
"You slaughtered tens of thousands of members of my Yaksha tribe and destroyed the millions of years of our Yaksha tribe's foundation. You will not die a good death!"
"When I die and turn into a fierce ghost, I will haunt you day and night!"
Facing Ye Yuan's vicious curses, Chu Feng's expression did not change at all.
"I will let you watch with your own eyes all the people of the Yasha clan die without burial."
Everyone in the Rakshasa clan took a breath of cold air, and one person saw his own clansman with his own eyes.Die one after another in front of him, this punishment is a thousand times crueler than killing him directly.
Ye Yuan's remnant soul trembled violently in the corpse palm. It was not until this moment that he truly realized what despair was.
The ancestor's divine will was chopped to pieces, and most of the clan members were massacred by corpse puppets. Even his self-destruction could not hurt a single hair of Chu Feng.
